n11dbb904be.headline: The National Bank tightens monetary policy
n11dbb904be.summary: The National Bank of Georgia has tightened monetary policy following a 6.8% depreciation of the lari against the dollar in recent months.
n11dbb904be.why: Monetary tightening aims to stabilize currency and control inflation, impacting financial markets and economic growth in Georgia.
n11dbb904be.why_moved: The lari's depreciation prompted the central bank to tighten policy to stabilize the currency and inflation expectations.
